title: TwistedCoordinateSectionOrdinary
statement: Fix a finite commutative ring $A$ in the standard coefficient universe and a scheme $T$. Use the affine line and its zero section [def-sbc-affine-space], its standard projective-line compactification [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], normalized trace [def-amb-p1-trace], and the coefficient-first ordinary line adjunction of [def-pur-coordinate-line-adjunction-maps]. Define $s_*$, $p_!$, and their existing adjunctions. Define $Rp_!s_*\simeq\mathrm{id}$ by the canonical compact-support compositor and $ps=\mathrm{id}$, and define $Rs^!Rp^!\simeq\mathrm{id}$ by its adjunction conjugate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate]. The supported class is the unique relative-boundary Kummer class, realized in the derived category, then expressed as the chart restriction of the projective shifted Tate line. For $M$, define the coefficient-first closed projection $p^*M\otimes s_*A\to s_*M$ by the canonical proper projection, $s^*p^*M\simeq M$, and the unit map. Whenever that specific projection is invertible, define the twisted supported arrow by its inverse followed by $1\otimes c_s$, and its ordinary exceptional adjunct by the closed adjunction. For positive invertible $N$ annihilating $A$ and Cartier $s$, OrdinaryNormalization is the proposition comprising: the open-counit image of the normalized supported class equals the pushed-forward projective Kummer Chern class; their traces agree and equal the identity; and for every $M_r=A_T(r)[2r]$ [def-trf-section-local-comparison-data], the closed projection is invertible, the twisted adjunct is invertible, its compact transpose equals $1_{M_r}$ tensor the untwisted integral (with right unitors), and its composite with the specified ordinary affine comparison and conjugate composition equals $1_{M_r}$. The existing constituent conventions and functors are [def-pur-conventions], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle], [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison], [def-pur-affine-line-datum]. The canonical untwisted arrows are those of [def-pur-coordinate-section-core-arrows].
